description: Forex 4-Pair Walk-Forward Retest. Structural mechanism: XGBoost binary classification of next-bar direction on a FIXED technical feature set (returns, volatility, ATR, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, session flags) — the same mechanism family as the original 2026-07-12 batch (runner scripts/run_multi_instrument_wf.py, artifact wf_batch_H1_20260712_200555.json). The original INCONCLUSIVE verdicts (USDCAD t=-1.69, USDCHF t=-1.12, AUDUSD t=-1.55, NZDUSD t=-0.53) were invalid as evidence: F24 loader-provenance gap (now resolved) and 5/6 pairs ran with UNMEASURED default costs (--allow-default-costs). This retest runs the SAME mechanism with measured FROM_TICKS costs (mandatory) and a pre-registered min_confidence reduction 0.65->0.55 to overcome the ~7-trades/fold underpoweredness.
current_verdict_2026-08-06: REJECTED — all 4 pairs (t=-8.15 to -17.41) at measured costs; INCONCLUSIVE resolved to REJECT.
sacred_holdout_path: N/A at the walk-forward stage (this is a validation-phase hypothesis, not a fitted-model holdout confirmation; sacred holdout remains LOCKED for Phase 4.5 only).
notes: Registered 2026-08-06 BEFORE running the retest, per pre-registration discipline (F27's lesson: never run-then-register).

Opened after Direction G stopped (§4.4, 2026-08-06) and after all 4 pairs received FROM_TICKS cost calibration (scripts/calibrate_forex4_from_ticks.py) — the cost-data blocker that excluded them since Direction D (2026-07-30) is resolved.
GBPUSD/USDJPY deliberately EXCLUDED — conclusively REJECTED in the original batch (t=-8.77 / t=-8.57) and remain closed.
min_confidence 0.65 -> 0.55 is frozen identically across all 4 pairs (no per-pair tuning, no lookahead at results).
Per F11 (MEGA_PLAN:37), INCONCLUSIVE is not a formal failure — this is a NEW hypothesis with real costs and a powered design.

result_summary.conclusion: ALL 4 PAIRS REJECT at measured FROM_TICKS costs with powered design (min_confidence 0.55, ~1900-6200 trades/pair). Original INCONCLUSIVE verdicts RESOLVED: the mechanism loses significantly (t=-8.2 to -17.4) — structural failure, not underpoweredness, not cost artifact. Direction H stopping-rule §4.4: 1st consecutive fail (needs 3).

hypotheses.notes: Direction H trial 9001 REJECTED 2026-08-06. Frozen params honored (min_confidence=0.55, measured costs, no --allow-default-costs). Resolves F24-era INCONCLUSIVE verdicts with real costs + powered design. GBPUSD/USDJPY remain closed (REJECTED t=-8.77/-8.57 in original batch).
